messages:
deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout v2.3.0-rc4 -> 5% global canary (rollout_id=rollout_3300001234). Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/v2.3.0-rc4. Change window: 2026-03-21 22:00-23:00 UTC. Advancing will auto-check signals every 5m.

maria: FYI — getting early alerts for eu-west. Can we gate until we confirm telemetry?

chris: Seeing tail latency ~1.8x on embeddings path in eu-west, and error rate +0.6% on /generate. Sampled traces show repeated kv-cache misses leading to backpressure.
```
# sampled log
2026-03-21T21:58:12Z pod/canary-abc: kv_cache.insert failed: OOM allocating 256Mi
2026-03-21T21:58:13Z pod/canary-abc: retrying insert -> increased GC pauses
```

anika: I pulled the pod logs + heap snapshots. Two canary pods hit sustained cache pressure. paste: https://short.link/logs/kv-oom-330000

lee: We should avoid a full global rollback if this is cache pressure only. Options: 1) reduce canary to 1% and hold; 2) split traffic by region and keep global 5%; 3) pin rollout and push a hotfix for cache limiter. What's the ops take?

maria: Quick vote — leaning toward region split so most users unaffected. @oncall-sre please advise. :eyes:

oncall-sre: Agreed. I'll pin eu-west back to v2.2.9 and leave the global canary at 5% for other regions. I'll also set the rollout to held to prevent auto-advance. ETA ~8m.

ops-bot: Run to apply split/pin:
```
# pin eu-west to previous release
deployctl rollout update --id rollout_3300001234 --region eu-west --target v2.2.9
# hold the global rollout to prevent further progress
deployctl rollout hold --id rollout_3300001234
# optionally reduce canary traffic
deployctl rollout set-traffic --id rollout_3300001234 --global-canary 1%
```

deploy-bot: rollout update applied: eu-west -> v2.2.9 (95% traffic), global canary remains 5% in other regions. Rollout state: HELD. Links: https://redwood.internal/rollouts/rollout_3300001234

chris: Starting kv-cache tuning on remaining canary pods (reduce max_entries, enable eviction hysteresis). Will monitor error + latency windows; will post updates in 15m.

anika: I added a quick config change to lower per-host cache allotment on canary. Monitoring dashboards updated.

maria: Consensus: split + hold. Reactions: :thumbsup: from maria, chris, lee, anika.

lee: Filing follow-up for a postmortem + release notes update to mention cache-limiter behavior and the mitigation we applied. I'll open the PR now.

maria: Thanks — keeping this thread pinned. If metrics regress we'll escalate to full rollback for eu-wide traffic.
